KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti f/v, s/z, l/r/ na th/dh.
